admin.stockCountHint: Book qty is frozen when you start. Staff type physical qty. Only the owner posts shortages to stock.
admin.auditStep1: 1. Pick the month and tap Start count — book qty freezes.
admin.auditStep2: 2. Count physical SKUs. Type counted qty. Save draft as you go.
admin.auditStep3: 3. Enter cash in hand and the bank statement figure.
admin.auditStep4: 4. Submit — lines lock. Do not change book qty.
admin.auditStep5: 5. Owner: shortages first, tick lines, Approve & post to stock, or Reject recount.
admin.auditClose1: 1. Finish stock and cash count for this month (staff submit).
admin.auditClose2: 2. Read exceptions first: shortages, uncounted SKUs, cash mismatch, GPS flags.
admin.auditClose3: 3. Approve or reject shortages on the count page, then print this report.
admin.auditClose4: 4. Sign counted / checked / owner. Optional: stamp month closed.

admin.auditEmptyUncounted: No uncounted SKUs with book qty.
admin.auditEmptyGps: No outside-fence or weak GPS punches.

admin.auditNotReadyShortages: Some shortage or uncounted lines are still pending.
admin.auditNotReadyCash: Accept cash or add a cash note first.
admin.auditAlreadyClosed: This month is already stamped closed.
admin.autoReorderHint: Cron only creates draft purchase orders. Staff still confirm before the supplier is told. Suggested qty covers lead time + safety stock, plus open estimates, minus stock already on the way.
admin.autoReorderCover: Cover days = supplier lead time + safety days (defaults 10 + 7). Average daily outward qty over the lookback window is multiplied by cover days. Tarpaulin / tirpal get a monsoon lift (May–Sep). Shade net stays 1.0. No sales in the window uses the staff min only.
admin.autoReorderEnableCron: Enable auto draft POs when cron runs
admin.autoReorderUseVelocity: Use sales velocity (fallback to min if no outward qty)

admin.schemesPageHint: Two kinds. This bill: qty of the same item adds up (all sizes); different items stay separate → ₹ off the rate (100 − 1 = 99), % off rate, ₹/kg off, or ₹ off the bill (not wallet). Final rate discount uses actual weighment. Wallet later: lift over the period → one credit after the end date.
admin.schemesHintBillRate: Each size is counted alone. Example: that size 100 kg or more → ₹1 off rate 100 → billed at ₹99 × actual kg. Mixing sizes does not add up. Not added to wallet.
admin.schemesHintBillPerKg: Each size is counted alone. Example: that size 100 kg or more → ₹2/kg off on that size only. Mixing sizes does not add up. Not added to wallet.
admin.schemesHintBillPct: Each size is counted alone. Example: that size 100 kg or more → 2% off that size. Mixing sizes does not add up. Not added to wallet.
admin.schemesHintBillFlat: A size must hit the step on its own (mixing sizes does not add up). Highest unlocked flat ₹ comes off the bill once. Not added to wallet.
admin.schemesHintWalletPct: Example: lift 1,000 kg → 1% of those sales into wallet. Lift 5,000 kg → 2%. One wallet credit after the end date — not off each bill.
admin.schemesHintWalletRate: Example: lift 1,000 kg → ₹1/kg on the full lift, paid to wallet after the end date — not off each bill.
admin.schemesWalletNote: Dealer sees this as a lifting scheme. Credit goes to wallet after the end date — it does not come off each bill.
admin.schemesMinBillQty: Per size on this bill, from ({unit})
admin.schemesTopBillFlat: Highest step: {amount} off this bill · {n} step(s)
admin.schemesTopWalletPct: Highest step: {pct}% of scheme sales to wallet · {n} step(s)
admin.schemesTopWalletRate: At top lift: {amount} to wallet · {n} step(s)
admin.schemesScopeHintBill: Only these products get the bill discount. Each size on the bill is counted separately.
admin.schemesScopeHintWallet: Only these products count toward lift / sales for the wallet credit.

admin.peopleJobsHint: Everyone with this job picks up edits immediately — you do not rewrite each staff row.

accounts.homeHint: Gateway like Tally: F5 Payment, F6 Receipt, F8 Sale, Alt+C Cash/Bank, Alt+B BRS. New sale opens an order; packing slip and bill follow. Verify UPI proofs on Payments desk, then tick the same credits in BRS. Press ? for shortcuts.

accounts.brsHint: Same idea as Tally Banking → Reconciliation. Tick lines that appear on today's bank statement, type the closing balance from the SMS/app, and add bank charges or interest that are on the statement but not yet in books. No paid gateway needed — UPI + proof + this match.
accounts.brsTickHint: Tick cleared cheques/UPI and add bank-only rows until difference is ₹0
accounts.brsFormula: Books − uncleared deposits + uncleared payments − bank charges + interest = bank statement.
accounts.brsEmpty: No entries up to this date.
accounts.brsBankOnlyHint: Charges, interest, or UPI that hit the bank but are not yet a voucher.
accounts.brsWaitingHint: Same amount and date as a proof — tick only after you see the bank SMS.
accounts.payHint: Collect on UPI / bank transfer (free). Dealer uploads proof — this list updates live. You tick verify here, then match the same credits in BRS against the daily bank statement. No payment-gateway fee.
accounts.payCollectHint: Share these UPI / account details. After bank SMS, tick the receipt in BRS.
accounts.payApplyHint: One UPI can cover several bills. Tick open invoices. Leftover stays on-account.
accounts.payOnAccount: No other open bills — leftover stays on-account.

accounts.bankNeedName: Enter a nickname or bank name

accounts.emptyStatement: Pick a party to see their statement.

accounts.goodsReceivedHint: Enter supplier, items and quantities. Attach the packing slip. Rates are set by the owner later.
accounts.needsPricingHint: Enter rates and optional freight / expenses, then post the supplier bill. Stock does not change again.
accounts.openingsHint: Bring stock, party balances and old unpaid bills from Tally into these books.
accounts.matchStatementHint: Tick lines that appear on both books. Add anything they show that we don't. Difference should go to zero.
accounts.controlsHint: Financial year, period lock, backup and books health.
accounts.purchasesHint: Owner direct bills. Day-to-day: staff use Goods received.
accounts.auditHint: Who posted or voided what — from voucher and GRN history.
